name: Westbound Panama Canal Butter Pecan, Dulce de Leche & Meringue Kisses Sundae
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Panama Canal Menu)
whyItWorks: Signature Panama Canal menu sundae; the airy egg-white meringue kisses and dulce de leche are fiber-free, but whole pecan pieces and dairy ice cream require modification.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to build this sundae using plain Vanilla Bean ice cream (or dairy-free ice cream) with the dulce de leche and crisp meringue kisses—holding the whole butter pecans.
watchOuts: Whole pecan pieces in butter pecan ice cream
High lactose in ice cream and dulce de leche
